title: Utility classes
description: A layout built only with NYSDS utility classes: grid, flex, spacing, and typography, with responsive prefixes.
html:
Stacks on mobile

This column is full width on mobile, half width on tablet, and a third on desktop.

Responsive by design

Prefix any utility class with a breakpoint, such as nys-desktop, to change it at that size.

No custom CSS

Every rule on this page comes from a utility class, not a stylesheet.

Stacks on mobile, row on tablet Flex utilities control direction and gap
